data: Microsoft's diluted earnings per share were $13.64 in fiscal 2025 (year ended June 30, 2025), compared with $11.80 in fiscal 2024, an increase of $1.84 or about 15.6%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $101,832 million (about $101.8 billion), up from $88,136 million in fiscal 2024. Diluted weighted average shares were roughly flat at 7,465 million in fiscal 2025 versus 7,469 million in fiscal 2024, so the EPS growth came almost entirely from higher earnings rather than share count reductions.
